005package org.wpilib.vision.apriltag;
006
007/** Loadable AprilTag field layouts. */
008public enum AprilTagFields {
009  /** 2022 Rapid React. */
010  k2022RapidReact("2022-rapidreact.json"),
011  /** 2023 Charged Up. */
012  k2023ChargedUp("2023-chargedup.json"),
013  /** 2024 Crescendo. */
014  k2024Crescendo("2024-crescendo.json"),
015  /** 2025 Reefscape Welded (see TU 12). */
016  k2025ReefscapeWelded("2025-reefscape-welded.json"),
017  /** 2025 Reefscape AndyMark (see TU 12). */
018  k2025ReefscapeAndyMark("2025-reefscape-andymark.json"),
019  /** 2026 Rebuilt Welded. */
020  k2026RebuiltWelded("2026-rebuilt-welded.json"),
021  /** 2026 Rebuilt AndyMark. */
022  k2026RebuiltAndymark("2026-rebuilt-andymark.json");
023
024  /** Base resource directory. */
025  public static final String kBaseResourceDir = "/org/wpilib/vision/apriltag/";
026
027  /** Alias to the current game. */
028  public static final AprilTagFields kDefaultField = k2026RebuiltWelded;
029
030  /** Resource filename. */
031  public final String resourceFile;
032
033  AprilTagFieldLayout fieldLayout;
034
035  AprilTagFields(String resourceFile) {
036    this.resourceFile = kBaseResourceDir + resourceFile;
037  }
038}
